description: In a prefix-closed finite-word tree, the height of a word is its length.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.wordTree_nodeHeight.{u} {X : Type u}
  (S : Set (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.WordNode X)) (hS : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.PrefixClosed S)
  (t : (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.wordTree S hS).carrier) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.nodeHeight (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.wordTree S hS) t = ↑(List.length ↑t)
